text.p: Supertyphoon Violet is a major threat in the Philippine Sea...

Supertyphoon Violet, with 150 mph winds, is over open waters near 20n/126e, and moving to the north northwest at about 7 mph. Violet will maintain intensity over the next 24 hours before very slowly weakening. By 36 to 48 hours, late Tuesday or early Wednesday local time, the storm may near Okinawa, Japan, as a major typhoon. Shipping will also be threatened in the waters south of Japan this period.
Typhoon Tom is moving away from the Mariana Islands...

Typhoon Tom, with 85 mph winds, is in the western Pacific near 22n/145e, moving north at 9 mph. Tom will continue to track away from the northern Mariana Islands with top winds between 75 and 80 mph during the next 24 hours before weakening and transitioning into an extratropical system as it rapidly tracks eastward. Tom will be a threat only to shipping.
